newsitem.title: USA: Actor Christian Slater arrested on assault charges.
newsitem.headline: Actor Christian Slater arrested on assault charges.

text.p: Actor Christian Slater, who costarred in "Interview with the Vampire," was charged with suspicion of assault with a deadly weapon on Monday following an argument with his girlfriend and a scuffle with police, a police spokesman said.
Det. Ron Phillips told a news conference that officers were called to a luxury condominium Monday morning in the Westwood neighbourhood and took Slater, 27, into custody.
The actor, who does not live in the building but was attending a party there, was charged with three counts of assault with a deadly weapon and one count of battery.
Phillips said Slater apparently got into a heated argument with his girlfriend as the party was winding down and a number of people intervened. About 25 people witnessed the argument, he added.
Details were sketchy, and Phillips declined to say what the deadly weapon was.

He said that after the arrest Slater was taken to a local hospital to be treated for unspecified injuries before being released back into police custody. "I won't elaborate on the injuries...but he's in fine condition," Phillips added.
He said the actor "became involved in an altercation with arresting officers."
Slater's publicist and agent were not immediately available to comment on his arrest.
